description: The drawing, headed "Diagram 3.2 Typical locations for guarding" on a green bar along the bottom, presents three line drawings arranged from left to right on a white background. The left drawing shows a thin vertical post topped by a small circle, rising from a vertical line, with a horizontal line extending to the left from the top of the vertical line; the words "Edge of floor" sit directly beneath the vertical line. The middle drawing depicts a similar vertical post with a circle at the top, rising from a vertical line that is connected to a horizontal line on the left by a short vertical drop and a horizontal step to the right, and it is likewise labelled "Edge of floor" below. The right drawing shows a flight of steps in section, descending from left to right, with a continuous diagonal handrail line and a series of vertical balusters between the rail and the treads; the word "Stair" is printed to the left of the steps. No dimensions, scales or additional symbols are shown.
